WGSRPD3_sampling.geometry_source: exact rWCVPdata wgsrpd3 object at commit 65bed76bae9d644ccb6ad200c05f9f5071d89e05
WGSRPD3_sampling.membership: retain lattice centers covered by each repaired WGSRPD3 geometry
WGSRPD3_sampling.cap_selection: if >25 points, retain the 25 smallest SHA256('hhm-wgsrpd3-sample-v0.1|<area_code_l3>|<latitude>|<longitude>') values, exact decimal strings from the fixed lattice
WGSRPD3_sampling.small_unit_fallback: if a unit covers no 0.5-degree lattice center, use exactly one sf point-on-surface/representative point generated from the exact frozen geometry
WGSRPD3_sampling.unit_weighting: sampling is an envelope support set only; climate-cloud nearest distance does not density-weight points or botanical units

climate.raster_interpolation: nearest raster cell through rasterio sample; no interpolation across nodata
climate.standardization_reference: all finite 0-BP climate vectors at the frozen WGSRPD3 support points, pooled once before species-specific host clouds
climate.missing: a support or edge position is invalid if any of the four variables is nonfinite/nodata at a required time

host_cloud.native_units: union of native, extant, nondoubtful WGSRPD3 units of the 1-3 exact WCVP-resolved recorded host species frozen in the candidate table
host_cloud.Q_host: all finite standardized 0-BP climate vectors at frozen support points in those units
host_cloud.failure: species predictor uncomputable; drop before panel split with no backfill

insect_self_cloud.Q_self: finite standardized 0-BP climate vectors at the insect's exact response-blind frozen genetic localities
insect_self_cloud.failure: species predictor uncomputable; drop before panel split with no backfill

edge_positions.interpolation: unique shortest great-circle arc between frozen endpoints; an exactly antipodal edge is uncomputable
